scope: All21 requirements and40 cases, capability fixtures, exact cited paragraphs of retained official manual, source identity/anchors, research boundaries and manifest payloads. Not a release or compatibility review.

semantic_checks.format_and_placement: VST2/VST3 and macOSAU2/AU3 and audio/MIDI role clauses supported; no arbitrary vendor/architecture compatibility inferred.
semantic_checks.parameter_panel: 64/65 boundary is conditional on independently verified modifiable/published counts and default-free instances; counting quirks remain U. Configure admission, warnings, reorder, editorless deletion restriction and per-instance persistence supported.
semantic_checks.promotion: Temporary chooser entries, promotion by envelope/X-Y/chooser actions, recording-stop panel admission and mapping-mode entry selection match retained paragraphs, including unusual select-another-parameter wording.
semantic_checks.windows: AutoOpen/Multiple/AutoHide, modifier preservation and global visibility precondition supported; no geometry or focus guarantee.
semantic_checks.sidechain: Mix0/100 and external Gain path clauses supported; Mute routing branch ambiguity has null oracle. No DSP mixing law or global mute inferred.
semantic_checks.program_and_AU: Program/bank ownership/save/load/rename and AU read-only/editor-only distinctions supported. VST2/VST3-specific binary formats and ambiguous AU extension spelling remain U.
semantic_checks.ownership: Discovery retains scanner behavior; rack/default, mapping/envelope/routing remain canonical dependencies. No scanner isolation claim imported into hosting.
semantic_checks.fixtures_and_numerics: Eight fixture definitions explicitly require independent vendor capability validation; no binaries, APIs or inferred candidate behavior provided. Numerical processing/timing/tolerance claims remain U.
semantic_checks.lifecycle: Opaque state, faults, cancel, undo, teardown and API/channel/latency obligations explicitly ungraded.

remaining_risk: All exact-build applicability and broad vendor/API/DSP/lifecycle behavior remain U. Review approves a bounded analyst draft, not full hosting coverage or implementation handoff.
